fixture_description: P076 stale lock recovery that used simple token replacement without verifying all required identity fields, allowing a window where two writers could proceed concurrently.
required_behavior: Stale lock recovery must use atomic compare-and-replace on the lock token. Token verification failure records observe_only and exits. Liveness must check hostname, boot/session identity, PID, process start time, command identity, and token.

recovery_attempt.risk: Another writer may have acquired the lock between the liveness check and the replacement, creating two concurrent writers.
